scope: All 72 CPU and 168 fresh automated requests. Human assignments, participant answers, live syslog, credentials and process-owner files excluded.
privacy: Inputs, outputs, case sources and frozen evaluation code are exact. Host path prefixes in runtime/model metadata are redacted; original hashes remain attestations, not independently available originals.
source_seal_limits: The original fresh seal includes a private human-assignment hash. That assignment is omitted and not verified publicly. Continuation driver is omitted because it hardcodes private paths; its source hash is retained in the original seal. Public verifier checks all measured requests and regenerated jobs without that driver.
